title: Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of a ten (10)-year Lease to The Condor Squadron Officer’s and Airmen’s Association Inc.: Covering use of aviation land and office building space
text:
[REGULAR ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Regular Items 19 - 25]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of a ten (10)-year Lease to The Condor Squadron Officer’s and Airmen’s Association Inc.: Covering use of aviation land and office building space located at Van Nuys Airport, for approximately $307,000 in total revenue over the full term (Jean-Pierre Tabet)
